problems.title: SynthDec F1 and P/R inconsistent under ordinary common-class interpretation
problems.assumptions: Same predictions/class/aggregation ordinaryF1; full reported rounding intervals
problems.check: Parent original visual inspection and independent harmonic-mean interval calculation
problems.counterevidence: Macro/run averaging can differ; definition unresolved; improvement ordering survives
problems.impact: Reported magnitude not self-consistent without additional definition, not falsified evaluation
problems.correction: Supply scoring convention/confusion matrices or correct table

focused_check.note: Verified the ordinary common-class/common-aggregation F1 formulas and complete nearest-integer rounding intervals: neither interval contains the printed F1. Macro or per-run aggregation could reconcile the entries, and improvement ordering survives. Minor reporting inconsistency remains conditional on the ordinary convention; exact scoring definitions and predictions remain missing.

problems.title: Auxiliary PRM formula lacks minimized-loss minus sign
problems.check: Derivative/concavity and endpoint analysis; original image
problems.result: Printed expression is maximized at target; minimizing reverses target direction
problems.counterevidence: MainpDPO Eq6 correctly negative; no actual training binding
problems.impact: Local formula/specification defect, baseline training error not established
problems.core_dependency: Auxiliary PRM comparison, not corepDPO algebra
problems.correction: Add minus or label maximized loglikelihood

focused_check.note: Verified the printed positive log-likelihood is concave and maximized at the target, so its stated minimization sign is wrong. The main pDPO loss has the correct negative sign. This supports a local Minor specification finding, not a claim that historical PRM training used the wrong sign.
